Comment: Updates by text all day, and the guys at the service desk were sound.
Parts were ready the same day, which was great, but I left two messages with the counter and never heard back. Had to drive in to find out anything.

My husband passed away last year and he always handled the car. I felt quite foolish being talked down to by the girl at reception when I didn't know the terms she was using. She could have been kinder.
Honestly no idea what they did under the bonnet but it was in and out in an hour and the bill was way less than I braced for. (rego CW50YT)
So easy. Honestly.
Speedy work, yes But they've left a tool, a greasy rag actually, under my seat
Quick and cheap. Can't ask for more.
Lightning Didn't even get through the magazine
Took forever and I only heard from you after I'd rung twice. Not good enough.
good humoured, welcoming and happy to have a yarn. makes a change. (rego XB13WP)
Done fast, picked up on time, back to my day. Good one.
Treated like a nuisance from the second I walked in. I was polite throughout and got nothing back.
Appreciate the clear explanation of how the roof bars lock and how to adjust them. Easy peasy.
i was kept well informed. the quote and the bill were two different numbers. (rego SX08VN)
As a student I'm counting every dollar, and the staff never made me feel small for it. Kind, patient and chatty.
Still no idea if the EV is done. Might just walk down there.

Timing belt, coolant flush and diff oil done for less than I'd budgeted, and the parts pricing looked right against what I'd pay retail. That said, I rang the workshop after lunch about a seized bolt they'd mentioned, was promised a call by close, and it never arrived. Had to ring again next morning to get any answer. For a job with a decision point in it, that's a process failure. Call me on 0446 809 000.
Cheers for explaining what a cabin filter is. Had no idea I even had one.
Please make someone responsible for calling customers back. I have waited many days for anwser about my car and nobody tell me anything.
Texted me progress photos of nothing, but still, I knew what was going on. Beats silence any day.
Honestly thought I'd be left hanging all day, but the texts rolled in and I could get on with my work.
Took less time than my usual trip to the shops. Very efficient.
Polite, warm, accommodating. Splendid staff. (rego BL92RJ)
Moved here a fortnight ago and had no idea what to expect. Was told 20 minutes for the part and it was 15. Can't complain about that.
Service was done in a flash, reckon it was quicker than the time they gave me. (rego HB27AA)
Knew exactly what I wanted on the E3 and the salesman never talked down to me. Pleasant bloke, happy to help.

Been buying cars from this gruop for over twenty years and never once have I been spoken to like that. Nat cut me off mid-sentence and said he'd 'get to me when he got to me'. Disappointing. Email me sandeep_dissanayake@gmail.com
Our local dealer back home never explained half this stuff. Josh here went through the key fob functions, the app, and what the dash menus do, step by step, and let me have a go at each one.
The whole purchase went through without a hitch. I'd expect nothing less afetr all these years as a customer.
Time-efficient and punctual. The vehicle was ready exactly when I was told it would be.
wow, a salesperson who talks like a normal human. shock horror, i understood the whole lot.
Friendly and honest as ever, which is why I keep coming back. This time though the sound from the front wheel is still there, so I'm a bit disappointed.
Thank you for calling me during the service. I was not happy to pay more than the estimate.
left a voicemail, sent a text, and emailed. triple silence.
money well spent. calls unanswered.
My wife and I only dropped it off at nine and we were having a cuppa at home by half past ten. Very handy.
Explained things nicely, but I got the car back with the back seat covered in dust and a smear of grease on the door, with the kids' car seats shifted around.
Right, so I know my way around a spanner, and I was braced for a fight. Turns out the sales team were just decent, friendly folks. Credit where it's due.
Did the whole thing from my phone between lectures. Seriously, no back and forth, just a few taps and it was done.
Very fast service for my EV. Happy with how quick it was.
I'd booked the first slot of the day so I could get the kids to school and be back for pickup. Car wasn't ready until after 2, so that plan went out the window.
Brake pads for the EV were sorted before lunch, couldn't ask for faster. Shame the total at the register had a heap of extras tacked on that I never got told about.
Everything was explained in a way I could follow, from the handover to the rego paperwork. (rego RB93NL)
Had two kids in the back fighting over a tablet and braced myself for a huge bill. Total was way less than I figured, so that's one less thing to stress about this month.
Raj was wonderful and went out of his way to help me, but I was left on hold for ages every time I rang. Gave up and drove in instead.
Better than expected on price, full stop.

I'm new to the area so I picked this place based on reviews, and I wish I hadn't I dropped my S4 off for a brake noise on Monday, was told I'd get a call by Tuesday afternoon, and heard nothing until I rang them myself on Thursday When I collected it the squealing was exactly the same, and the service advisor seemed surprised I was back so soon
Didn't wait more than a minute or two for my air filter. Very handy when you're on your lunch break.
Clear explanation of the loan term and how extra repayments would work. Didn't feel talked down to. (rego FM11SP)
Honestly the kindest bunch I've dealt with at any business this year.
The tech notes were translated into something I could understand, and Nat even pointed out where on the car each thing was.
Priced up a service online, turned up, and the price had mysteriously gone up $90 because of my EV being a 'premium vehicle'. Since when?
